title: The Past and Present Lives of a Dog

series.title: The Past and Present Lives of a Dog

fullText.simplified:
十三、后记

    因为有佛教的影响，中国人有“轮回”的说法。什么是“轮回”呢？从开始到结束，然后再重新开始，像车轮一样，一直不停地转，这就是“轮回”。比如，一年有春夏秋冬四个季节，一年过完，新的一年到来，然后又有了新的春夏秋冬。一天有白天和晚上，一天过完，新的一天到来，然后又有了新的白天和晚上。人有生老病死，一生过完，新的一生到来，然后又有了新的生老病死。
    “奈何桥”是中国神话中一个地方，是人死以后，开始新的“轮回”以前，一定会经过的一个地方。人们觉得“奈何桥”的一边是“前世”，意思是以前的世界，以前的生活；桥的另一边是“来生”，意思是以后的世界，以后的生活。过桥的人和动物，都会遇到一个老人，她就是孟婆。孟婆的工作是给他们一碗汤，这碗汤叫“孟婆汤”。喝了“孟婆汤”的人和动物，就会忘了“前世”的人和事情，重新开始新的一生。
    生活里你可以这样用这些词：
    比如你和一个朋友刚认识几天，但是你觉得对他特别地熟悉，好像认识很久的老朋友，你可以开玩笑说：“我们可能前世认识。”
    比如在一些电影里，有的坏人在死的时候，会说：“如果有来生，我一定要做个好人。”
    在日常生活中，“孟婆汤”和“奈何桥”一般是用来开玩笑的。比如，一个刚刚学会说话的小孩非常聪明，经常像大人一样说话，有时好像比大人还聪明，这时候就可以开玩笑说“这个小孩没有喝孟婆汤”或者“孟婆忘记给这个小孩喝汤了”。意思是这个小孩太聪明了，好像没有忘记前世学过的东西。
    好了，现在你已经知道“孟婆汤”和“奈何桥”的意思了。下面有个小故事，你能听懂故事中女孩的话吗？
    男孩和女孩在桥边分手了，女孩非常难过，对男孩说：“过了这座桥，我就会忘记你，以后的人生都不记得你。”男孩听不懂，问为什么，女孩说：“这座桥就是我的奈何桥，过桥的时候我会喝一碗汤。”
fullText.traditional:
十三、後記

    因為有佛教的影響，中國人有“輪迴”的說法。什麼是“輪迴”呢？從開始到結束，然後再重新開始，像車輪一樣，一直不停地轉，這就是“輪迴”。比如，一年有春夏秋冬四個季節，一年過完，新的一年到來，然後又有了新的春夏秋冬。一天有白天和晚上，一天過完，新的一天到來，然後又有了新的白天和晚上。人有生老病死，一生過完，新的一生到來，然後又有了新的生老病死。
    “奈何橋”是中國神話中一個地方，是人死以後，開始新的“輪迴”以前，一定會經過的一個地方。人們覺得“奈何橋”的一邊是“前世”，意思是以前的世界，以前的生活；橋的另一邊是“來生”，意思是以後的世界，以後的生活。過橋的人和動物，都會遇到一個老人，她就是孟婆。孟婆的工作是給他們一碗湯，這碗湯叫“孟婆湯”。喝了“孟婆湯”的人和動物，就會忘了“前世”的人和事情，重新開始新的一生。
    生活裡你可以這樣用這些詞：
    比如你和一個朋友剛認識幾天，但是你覺得對他特別地熟悉，好像認識很久的老朋友，你可以開玩笑說：“我們可能前世認識。”
    比如在一些電影裡，有的壞人在死的時候，會說：“如果有來生，我一定要做個好人。”
    在日常生活中，“孟婆湯”和“奈何橋”一般是用來開玩笑的。比如，一個剛剛學會說話的小孩非常聰明，經常像大人一樣說話，有時好像比大人還聰明，這時候就可以開玩笑說“這個小孩沒有喝孟婆湯”或者“孟婆忘記給這個小孩喝湯了”。意思是這個小孩太聰明了，好像沒有忘記前世學過的東西。
    好了，現在你已經知道“孟婆湯”和“奈何橋”的意思了。下面有個小故事，你能聽懂故事中女孩的話嗎？
    男孩和女孩在橋邊分手了，女孩非常難過，對男孩說：“過了這座橋，我就會忘記你，以後的人生都不記得你。”男孩聽不懂，問為什麼，女孩說：“這座橋就是我的奈何橋，過橋的時候我會喝一碗湯。”

sentences.pinyin: shén me shì lún huí ne cóng kāi shǐ dào jié shù rán hòu zài chóng xīn kāi shǐ
sentences.english: So, what is “reincarnation”? It is going from beginning to end and then starting once again.

sentences.simplified: 像车轮一样，一直不停地转，这就是“轮回”。
sentences.traditional: 像車輪一樣，一直不停地轉，這就是“輪迴”。

sentences.english: It is always turning, like a wheel. This is “reincarnation”.

sentences.pinyin: bǐ rú yì nián yǒu chūn xià qiū dōng sì ge jì jié
sentences.english: For example, every year has four seasons—spring, summer, autumn, and winter.

sentences.simplified: 一年过完，新的一年到来，然后又有了新的春夏秋冬。
sentences.traditional: 一年過完，新的一年到來，然後又有了新的春夏秋冬。

sentences.english: One year passes, and a new year arrives. Then there is a new spring, summer, autumn, and winter.

sentences.simplified: 一天有白天和晚上，一天过完，新的一天到来，然后又有了新的白天和晚上。
sentences.traditional: 一天有白天和晚上，一天過完，新的一天到來，然後又有了新的白天和晚上。
sentences.pinyin: yì tiān yǒu bái tiān hé wǎn shang yì tiān guò wán xīn de yì tiān dào lái rán hòu yòu yǒu le xīn de bái tiān hé wǎn shang
sentences.english: One day has daytime and nighttime. One day passes, and a new day arrives. Then there is a new daytime and nighttime.

sentences.simplified: 人有生老病死，一生过完，新的一生到来，
sentences.traditional: 人有生老病死，一生過完，新的一生到來，
sentences.pinyin: rén yǒu shēng lǎo bìng sǐ yì shēng guò wán xīn de yì shēng dào lái
sentences.english: People are born, grow old, get sick, and die. One life is over, and a new life arrives.

sentences.simplified: 然后又有了新的生老病死。
sentences.traditional: 然後又有了新的生老病死。
sentences.pinyin: rán hòu yòu yǒu le xīn de shēng lǎo bìng sǐ
sentences.english: Then, the new life is born, grows old, gets sick, and dies.

sentences.simplified: “奈何桥”是中国神话中一个地方，
sentences.traditional: “奈何橋”是中國神話中一個地方，
sentences.pinyin: nài hé qiáo shì zhōng guó shén huà zhōng yí ge dì fang
sentences.english: The “Bridge of Helplessness” is a place in Chinese mythology ..

sentences.simplified: 是人死以后，开始新的“轮回”以前，一定会经过的一个地方。
sentences.traditional: 是人死以後，開始新的“輪迴”以前，一定會經過的一個地方。
sentences.pinyin: shì rén sǐ yǐ hòu kāi shǐ xīn de lún huí yǐ qián yí dìng huì jīng guò de yí ge dì fang
sentences.english: .. that people must pass through after death before starting a new “reincarnation”.

sentences.simplified: 人们觉得“奈何桥”的一边是“前世”，意思是以前的世界，以前的生活；
sentences.traditional: 人們覺得“奈何橋”的一邊是“前世”，意思是以前的世界，以前的生活；
sentences.pinyin: rén men jué de nài hé qiáo de yì biān shì qián shì yì si shì yǐ qián de shì jiè yǐ qián de shēng huó
sentences.english: People think that one side of the Bridge of Helplessness is the “past life”, meaning the previous world and previous life.

sentences.simplified: 桥的另一边是“来生”，意思是以后的世界，以后的生活。
sentences.traditional: 橋的另一邊是“來生”，意思是以後的世界，以後的生活。
sentences.pinyin: qiáo de lìng yì biān shì lái shēng yì si shì yǐ hòu de shì jiè yǐ hòu de shēng huó
sentences.english: The other side of the bridge is the “afterlife”, meaning the future world and the next life.

sentences.simplified: 过桥的人和动物，都会遇到一个老人，她就是孟婆。
sentences.traditional: 過橋的人和動物，都會遇到一個老人，她就是孟婆。
sentences.pinyin: guò qiáo de rén hé dòng wù dōu huì yù dào yí ge lǎo rén tā jiù shì mèng pó
sentences.english: People and animals who cross the bridge will meet an elderly person. She is Meng Po.

sentences.traditional: 孟婆的工作是給他們一碗湯，這碗湯叫“孟婆湯”。
sentences.pinyin: mèng pó de gōng zuò shì gěi tā men yì wǎn tāng zhè wǎn tāng jiào mèng pó tāng
sentences.english: Meng Po’s job is to give everyone a bowl of soup, which is called “Meng Po soup”.

sentences.simplified: 喝了“孟婆汤”的人和动物，就会忘了“前世”的人和事情，重新开始新的一生。
sentences.traditional: 喝了“孟婆湯”的人和動物，就會忘了“前世”的人和事情，重新開始新的一生。
sentences.pinyin: hē le mèng pó tāng de rén hé dòng wù jiù huì wàng le qián shì de rén hé shì qing chóng xīn kāi shǐ xīn de yì shēng
sentences.english: People and animals who drink “Meng Po soup” will forget the people and events of their “past lives” and start over with a new life.

sentences.pinyin: shēng huó lǐ nǐ kě yǐ zhè yàng yòng zhè xiē cí
sentences.english: You can use these words in your everyday life like this.

sentences.traditional: 比如你和一個朋友剛認識幾天，

sentences.english: For example, you just met a new friend a few days ago.

sentences.simplified: 但是你觉得对他特别地熟悉，好像认识很久的老朋友，
sentences.traditional: 但是你覺得對他特別地熟悉，好像認識很久的老朋友，
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì nǐ jué de duì tā tè bié de shú xī hǎo xiàng rèn shi hěn jiǔ de lǎo péng you
sentences.english: But you feel particularly familiar with them, like they’re an old friend you have known for a long time.

sentences.simplified: 你可以开玩笑说：“我们可能前世认识。”
sentences.traditional: 你可以開玩笑說：“我們可能前世認識。”
sentences.pinyin: nǐ kě yǐ kāi wán xiào shuō wǒ men kě néng qián shì rèn shi
sentences.english: You can say as a joke, “We probably knew each other in a past life.”

sentences.simplified: 比如在一些电影里，有的坏人在死的时候，会说：“如果有来生，我一定要做个好人。”
sentences.traditional: 比如在一些電影裡，有的壞人在死的時候，會說：“如果有來生，我一定要做個好人。”
sentences.pinyin: bǐ rú zài yì xiē diàn yǐng lǐ yǒu de huài rén zài sǐ de shí hou huì shuō rú guǒ yǒu lái shēng wǒ yí dìng yào zuò ge hǎo rén
sentences.english: For example, in some movies, there are bad guys who say when they die, “If there is an afterlife, I will definitely be a good person.”

sentences.simplified: 在日常生活中，“孟婆汤”和“奈何桥”一般是用来开玩笑的。
sentences.traditional: 在日常生活中，“孟婆湯”和“奈何橋”一般是用來開玩笑的。
sentences.pinyin: zài rì cháng shēng huó zhōng mèng pó tāng hé nài hé qiáo yì bān shì yòng lái kāi wán xiào de
sentences.english: In daily life, “Meng Po soup” and the “Bridge of Helplessness” are generally used as jokes.

sentences.simplified: 比如，一个刚刚学会说话的小孩非常聪明，经常像大人一样说话，
sentences.traditional: 比如，一個剛剛學會說話的小孩非常聰明，經常像大人一樣說話，

sentences.english: For example, if a child who has just learned to speak is very smart and often talks like an adult, ..

sentences.english: .. and sometimes seems even smarter than an adult, ..

sentences.traditional: 這時候就可以開玩笑說“這個小孩沒有喝孟婆湯”或者“孟婆忘記給這個小孩喝湯了”。

sentences.english: .. then you can joke, “This child did not drink Meng Po soup” or “Meng Po forgot to give this child soup”.

sentences.traditional: 意思是這個小孩太聰明了，好像沒有忘記前世學過的東西。

sentences.english: It means that this child is so smart that he seems to have not forgotten what he learned in his past life.

sentences.english: Here is a short story. Can you understand what the girl in the story is saying?

sentence_translations: (13) Epilogue
Due to the influence of Buddhism, Chinese people have the concept of “reincarnation”.
So, what is “reincarnation”? It is going from beginning to end and then starting once again.
It is always turning, like a wheel. This is “reincarnation”.
For example, every year has four seasons—spring, summer, autumn, and winter.
One year passes, and a new year arrives. Then there is a new spring, summer, autumn, and winter.
One day has daytime and nighttime. One day passes, and a new day arrives. Then there is a new daytime and nighttime.
People are born, grow old, get sick, and die. One life is over, and a new life arrives.
Then, the new life is born, grows old, gets sick, and dies.
The “Bridge of Helplessness” is a place in Chinese mythology ..
.. that people must pass through after death before starting a new “reincarnation”.
People think that one side of the Bridge of Helplessness is the “past life”, meaning the previous world and previous life.
The other side of the bridge is the “afterlife”, meaning the future world and the next life.
People and animals who cross the bridge will meet an elderly person. She is Meng Po.
Meng Po’s job is to give everyone a bowl of soup, which is called “Meng Po soup”.
People and animals who drink “Meng Po soup” will forget the people and events of their “past lives” and start over with a new life.
You can use these words in your everyday life like this.
For example, you just met a new friend a few days ago.
But you feel particularly familiar with them, like they’re an old friend you have known for a long time.
You can say as a joke, “We probably knew each other in a past life.”
For example, in some movies, there are bad guys who say when they die, “If there is an afterlife, I will definitely be a good person.”
In daily life, “Meng Po soup” and the “Bridge of Helplessness” are generally used as jokes.
For example, if a child who has just learned to speak is very smart and often talks like an adult, ..
.. and sometimes seems even smarter than an adult, ..
.. then you can joke, “This child did not drink Meng Po soup” or “Meng Po forgot to give this child soup”.
It means that this child is so smart that he seems to have not forgotten what he learned in his past life.
Well, now you already know the meaning of “Meng Po soup” and the “Bridge of Helplessness”.
Here is a short story. Can you understand what the girl in the story is saying?
A boy and a girl broke up next to a bridge. The girl was very sad and said to the boy, ..
.. “After crossing this bridge, I will forget you. I will not remember you for the rest of my life.”
The boy didn’t understand what she meant. He asked why, and the girl said, ..
.. “This bridge is my Bridge of Helplessness. When I cross the bridge, I will drink a bowl of soup.”
